content.short: Yay! is a Japanese SocialFi app for communities built around shared interests.
content.description: Yay! is a social network from Japan organised around interest-based communities, with a SocialFi layer that includes the YAY token, staking and NFTs. It integrated World ID to keep its communities human, and it is listed in World's official ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Yay! is a Japanese interest-based SocialFi network that integrates World ID, listed in World's ecosystem.
